- [RARC.5.7.4] **Call dispatcher.** Invokes the integrator's call callback
  with the service, the correlation, the arguments and the identity of the
  firing that issued it. The correlation is the call's `as` value or the one the
  compiler generated for it ([LCRS.3.1]); the dispatcher allocates none. It keeps no per-call deadline either; timeouts are the
  adapter's ([LCRS.7.3]).
